title: SpeC2Rust: Specification-Driven Repository-Level C-to-Rust Translation
title_zh: SpeC2Rust：规格驱动的仓库级C到Rust翻译

paragraphs.en: Legacy C codebases remain central to system software and performance-critical infrastructure, while their weak memory-safety guarantees continue to impose substantial security and maintenance risks. Recent C-to-Rust translation systems, including translators based on large language models (LLMs), have made automated migration increasingly feasible. However, LLM-based translation still faces several challenges. Existing methods often preserve the original C skeleton, making it difficult to recover project intent and module functionalities at repository scale. The translated Rust code may still rely on raw pointers and unsafe constructs. Cross-file interfaces and dependency relations are also difficult to maintain consistently across generated Rust modules. Even when initial translation succeeds, the resulting project still requires costly compilation repair and end-to-end validation, while naively accumulated context during this process can degrade repair stability and efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 遗留 C 代码库仍然是系统软件和性能关键型基础设施的核心，但其薄弱的内存安全保证持续带来重大的安全与维护风险。 近年来的 C 到 Rust 转换系统，包括基于大语言模型（LLM）的转换器，已使自动化迁移日益可行。 然而，基于 LLM 的转换仍面临若干挑战。 现有方法通常保留原始的 C 代码骨架，难以在仓库规模上恢复项目意图和模块功能。 转换得到的 Rust 代码可能仍依赖原始指针和不安全构造。 跨文件接口与依赖关系也难以在生成的各个 Rust 模块之间保持一致。 即使初始转换成功，所得项目仍需代价高昂的编译修复和端到端验证，而在此过程中简单累积的上下文可能降低修复的稳定性与效率。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose SpeC2Rust , a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation. SpeC2Rust consists of three stages: (1) Project-Intent Structuring , which decomposes the C repository into semantically coherent modules and generates persistent repository-level and module-level specification documents; (2) Spec-Guided Generation , which translates each Rust module against these specifications with a live symbol registry to maintain cross-file consistency instead of collapsing the translated system into poorly structured monolithic Rust files; (3) Layered-Feedback Repair , which organizes repair into targeted batches and injects only failure-relevant diagnostics, specification context, and source evidence to support efficient compilation and test-driven correction.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SpeC2Rust，一个规范驱动的仓库级 C 到 Rust 翻译流水线。 SpeC2Rust 由三个阶段组成：(1) 项目意图结构化，将 C 仓库分解为语义连贯的模块，并生成持久化的仓库级和模块级规范文档；(2) 规范引导生成，依据这些规范翻译每个 Rust 模块，并借助实时符号注册表来保持跨文件一致性，而不是将翻译后的系统压缩为结构糟糕的单体 Rust 文件；(3) 分层反馈修复，将修复组织为有针对性的批次，并只注入与失败相关的诊断信息、规范上下文和源码证据，以支持高效的编译和测试驱动的纠错。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SpeC2Rust on eight repository-level C projects. On eight repository-level C projects, SpeC2Rust generates Rust projects that compile and pass the original end-to-end tests. The generated code contains no raw-pointer declarations, raw-pointer dereferences, or unsafe lines. On the projects shared with the compared LLM-based baseline, SpeC2Rust reduces cost by 66.1% and input-token usage by 84.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在八个仓库级 C 项目上评估 SpeC2Rust。 在八个仓库级 C 项目上，SpeC2Rust 生成的 Rust 项目能够编译通过并通过原有的端到端测试。 生成的代码不包含任何裸指针声明、裸指针解引用或 unsafe 行。 在与所比较的基于大语言模型的基线共享的项目上，SpeC2Rust 将成本降低了 66.1%，输入 token 用量降低了 84.7%。

paragraphs.en: Modernizing legacy C code is a long-standing problem in software engineering. C provides weak memory-safety guarantees and a limited type system, which lead to high maintenance cost and frequent security vulnerabilities [ 1 ] . By contrast, Rust is increasingly regarded as a practical replacement for C because of its ownership and borrowing mechanisms, together with its strong memory-safety guarantees [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现代化改造遗留 C 代码是软件工程中一个长期存在的问题。 C 语言提供的内存安全保障较弱，类型系统也有限，这导致了高昂的维护成本和频繁的安全漏洞 [ 1 ] 。 相比之下，Rust 凭借其所有权与借用机制以及强大的内存安全保障，日益被视为 C 语言的实际替代方案 [ 2 ] 。

sents.en: Modernizing legacy C code is a long-standing problem in software engineering.
sents.zh: 现代化改造遗留 C 代码是软件工程中一个长期存在的问题。

sents.en: C provides weak memory-safety guarantees and a limited type system, which lead to high maintenance cost and frequent security vulnerabilities [ 1 ] .

sents.en: By contrast, Rust is increasingly regarded as a practical replacement for C because of its ownership and borrowing mechanisms, together with its strong memory-safety guarantees [ 2 ] .
sents.zh: 相比之下，Rust 凭借其所有权与借用机制以及强大的内存安全保障，日益被视为 C 语言的实际替代方案 [ 2 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Rule-based translation tools such as C2Rust [ 3 ] can quickly translate C code into Rust. However, prior studies show that eliminating unsafe code while preserving translation quality remains difficult in practice [ 4 , 5 ] . In parallel, LLMs have demonstrated strong capability in software engineering tasks, especially code understanding, code generation [ 6 ] , and program repair [ 7 ] . Systems such as C2SaferRust [ 8 ] and SmartC2Rust [ 9 ] use LLMs to generate safer Rust code, but LLM-based translation still faces several major challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 C2Rust [3] 之类的基于规则的翻译工具可以快速将 C 代码翻译为 Rust。 然而，先前的研究表明，在实践中，在保持翻译质量的同时消除不安全代码仍然很困难 [4, 5]。 与此同时，大语言模型在软件工程任务中展现出强大的能力，尤其是在代码理解、代码生成 [6] 和程序修复 [7] 方面。 诸如 C2SaferRust [8] 和 SmartC2Rust [9] 之类的系统使用大语言模型来生成更安全的 Rust 代码，但基于大语言模型的翻译仍然面临若干重大挑战。

paragraphs.en: Project-level C-to-Rust migration raises four challenges that are not adequately addressed by existing approaches:
paragraphs.zh: 项目级的 C 到 Rust 迁移提出了四个现有方法尚未充分解决的挑战：

paragraphs.en: C Project Intent. LLM-generated Rust code may pass end-to-end tests while still being semantically incomplete or even degenerating into a pseudo implementation. In such cases, the translated result no longer preserves the original algorithmic logic of the C project.
paragraphs.zh: C 项目意图。 由大语言模型生成的 Rust 代码可能通过端到端测试，但仍在语义上不完整，甚至退化为伪实现。 在这种情况下，翻译结果不再保留 C 项目原有的算法逻辑。

sents.en: C Project Intent.
sents.zh: C 项目意图。

sents.en: LLM-generated Rust code may pass end-to-end tests while still being semantically incomplete or even degenerating into a pseudo implementation.
sents.zh: 由大语言模型生成的 Rust 代码可能通过端到端测试，但仍在语义上不完整，甚至退化为伪实现。

sents.en: In such cases, the translated result no longer preserves the original algorithmic logic of the C project.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，翻译结果不再保留 C 项目原有的算法逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Memory Safety. Previous approaches often construct a Rust skeleton that closely matches the original C project layout, or directly perform function-level translation over the unsafe Rust generated by C2Rust . As a result, the translated Rust code remains centered around unsafe pointers and blocks, with limited memory-safety guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 内存安全性。 已有的方法往往构建一个与原始 C 项目结构高度一致的 Rust 骨架，或者直接对 C2Rust 生成的非安全 Rust 代码进行函数级翻译。 因此，翻译得到的 Rust 代码仍然以非安全指针和非安全代码块为中心，内存安全性保证十分有限。

sents.en: Memory Safety.
sents.zh: 内存安全性。

sents.en: Previous approaches often construct a Rust skeleton that closely matches the original C project layout, or directly perform function-level translation over the unsafe Rust generated by C2Rust .
sents.zh: 已有的方法往往构建一个与原始 C 项目结构高度一致的 Rust 骨架，或者直接对 C2Rust 生成的非安全 Rust 代码进行函数级翻译。

sents.en: As a result, the translated Rust code remains centered around unsafe pointers and blocks, with limited memory-safety guarantees.
sents.zh: 因此，翻译得到的 Rust 代码仍然以非安全指针和非安全代码块为中心，内存安全性保证十分有限。

paragraphs.en: Cross-file Dependencies. Rust projects are organized around modules with explicit dependency relationships. Existing methods sometimes place most or all translated Rust code into a single .rs file. Although this design avoids dependency management across files, it yields poor code organization and weak maintainability. Moreover, as the size of the C project increases, the translation success rate tends to decrease [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 跨文件依赖。 Rust 项目围绕具有显式依赖关系的模块进行组织。 现有方法有时会将大部分或全部翻译后的 Rust 代码放入单个 .rs 文件中。 尽管这种设计避免了跨文件的依赖管理，但它导致代码组织不佳、可维护性较弱。 此外，随着 C 项目规模的增大，翻译成功率往往会下降 [ 10 ] 。

sents.en: Cross-file Dependencies.
sents.zh: 跨文件依赖。

sents.en: Rust projects are organized around modules with explicit dependency relationships.

paragraphs.en: Program Repair. The translated Rust project must be repaired through compilation and testing to ensure behavioral consistency with the original C project. Current methods often feed compiler outputs together with Rust source files back to the LLM, which causes excessive context accumulation and reduces repair effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 程序修复。 翻译后的 Rust 项目必须通过编译和测试进行修复，以确保与原 C 项目的行为一致性。 当前方法通常将编译器输出连同 Rust 源文件一起反馈给大语言模型，这会导致上下文过度累积，降低修复效果。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present SpeC2Rust , a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation. The main idea of SpeC2Rust is to explicitly externalize repository-level knowledge before code generation, preserve it as reusable specification artifacts, and reinject it on demand during subsequent generation and repair.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SpeC2Rust，一个由规范驱动的仓库级 C 到 Rust 翻译流水线。 SpeC2Rust 的核心思想是在代码生成之前显式外化仓库级知识，将其保存为可复用的规范工件，并在后续的生成与修复过程中按需重新注入这些知识。

sents.en: To address these challenges, we present SpeC2Rust , a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation.
sents.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SpeC2Rust，一个由规范驱动的仓库级 C 到 Rust 翻译流水线。

sents.en: The main idea of SpeC2Rust is to explicitly externalize repository-level knowledge before code generation, preserve it as reusable specification artifacts, and reinject it on demand during subsequent generation and repair.
sents.zh: SpeC2Rust 的核心思想是在代码生成之前显式外化仓库级知识，将其保存为可复用的规范工件，并在后续的生成与修复过程中按需重新注入这些知识。

paragraphs.en: During repair, SpeC2Rust organizes compilation diagnostics and test failures into structured repair batches, and uses iterative repair to preserve semantic consistency between the translated Rust project and the original C project. To prevent the repair model from bypassing real failures by directly modifying the tests, dataset test scripts are treated as read-only artifacts throughout repair. To address the four challenges above, SpeC2Rust uses three technical components. First, Project-Intent Structuring partitions the repository into functional modules and generates repository-level and module-level specifications from the recovered project facts. Second, Spec-Guided Generation translates each target module against these specifications and uses a live symbol registry with demand-driven evidence retrieval to maintain cross-file consistency. Third, Layered-Feedback Repair resolves build and test failures through targeted evidence injection, structured repair batching, and read-only test boundaries, thereby improving repair focus and preventing spurious success through test modification.
paragraphs.zh: 在修复过程中，SpeC2Rust 将编译诊断信息和测试失败整理成结构化的修复批次，并通过迭代修复来保持翻译后的 Rust 项目与原始 C 项目之间的语义一致性。 为防止修复模型通过直接修改测试来绕过真实失败，数据集测试脚本在整个修复过程中被视为只读产物。 为应对上述四个挑战，SpeC2Rust 使用了三项技术组件。 首先，项目意图结构化将代码仓库划分为功能模块，并从恢复的项目事实中生成仓库级和模块级规约。 其次，规约引导生成依据这些规约翻译每个目标模块，并使用带按需证据检索的实时符号注册表来维持跨文件一致性。 第三，分层反馈修复通过针对性证据注入、结构化修复批次和只读测试边界来解决构建和测试失败，从而提升修复的针对性，并通过测试修改防止虚假成功。

sents.en: During repair, SpeC2Rust organizes compilation diagnostics and test failures into structured repair batches, and uses iterative repair to preserve semantic consistency between the translated Rust project and the original C project.
sents.zh: 在修复过程中，SpeC2Rust 将编译诊断信息和测试失败整理成结构化的修复批次，并通过迭代修复来保持翻译后的 Rust 项目与原始 C 项目之间的语义一致性。

sents.en: To address the four challenges above, SpeC2Rust uses three technical components.

sents.en: First, Project-Intent Structuring partitions the repository into functional modules and generates repository-level and module-level specifications from the recovered project facts.

sents.en: Second, Spec-Guided Generation translates each target module against these specifications and uses a live symbol registry with demand-driven evidence retrieval to maintain cross-file consistency.
sents.zh: 其次，规约引导生成依据这些规约翻译每个目标模块，并使用带按需证据检索的实时符号注册表来维持跨文件一致性。

sents.en: Third, Layered-Feedback Repair resolves build and test failures through targeted evidence injection, structured repair batching, and read-only test boundaries, thereby improving repair focus and preventing spurious success through test modification.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SpeC2Rust on eight GitHub C projects. paragraphs.en: Existing skeleton-based C-to-Rust translation tools typically construct a Rust project skeleton aligned with the original C repository and then fill that skeleton with translated code. This design preserves FFI-style function boundaries, raw-pointer-based state, and global mutable variables, thereby carrying a large amount of unsafe code into the generated Rust project [ 11 , 12 ] . Moreover, because translation is performed mainly at the function and file levels, the resulting Rust code often fails to recover the module organization and interface structure required by an idiomatic Rust project [ 13 , 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基于骨架的 C 到 Rust 转换工具通常会构建一个与原始 C 仓库对齐的 Rust 项目骨架，然后用翻译后的代码填充该骨架。 这种设计保留了 FFI 风格的函数边界、基于裸指针的状态以及全局可变变量，从而将大量不安全（unsafe）代码带入了生成的 Rust 项目 [ 11 , 12 ] 。 此外，由于转换主要在函数和文件级别进行，所得的 Rust 代码往往无法恢复符合惯用法的 Rust 项目所需的模块组织与接口结构 [ 13 , 14 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we propose SpeC2Rust , a specification-driven C-to-Rust translation workflow. paragraphs.en: Candidates whose score exceeds a threshold are materialized directly as module units. The remaining candidates are refined using three strategies applied in sequence. Struct split groups functions that access the same struct type. Prefix split groups functions sharing a common name prefix (e.g., ast_* , ir_gen_* ), capturing the naming conventions C projects use to delimit logical subsystems. File-local split groups remaining functions by source file. We chunk oversized groups further to stay within LLM context size limits. paragraphs.en: We convert each module unit into a three-document specification bundle. The bundle includes a requirement document covering translation obligations, an implementation plan for Rust-side organization, and a task-decomposition document listing executable translation steps. At the project level, it produces a rewrite context capturing repository structure, subsystem boundaries, public interfaces, and behavioral constraints. It also produces a translation contract defining the expected Rust-side generation boundary. During generation, we retrieve the relevant specification rather than passing raw C source to the model. During repair, the same documents supply source-grounded context for interpreting compiler diagnostics and test failures. Figure 3 shows example produced documents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个模块单元转换为一组由三份文档组成的规范。 该组文档包括一份涵盖翻译义务的需求文档、一份用于 Rust 侧组织的实施计划，以及一份列出可执行翻译步骤的任务分解文档。 在项目层面，它会生成一个重写上下文，捕获仓库结构、子系统边界、公共接口和行为约束。 它还会生成一份翻译契约，定义预期的 Rust 侧生成边界。 在生成过程中，我们检索相关的规范，而不是将原始 C 源码传给模型。 在修复过程中，同样的文档为解释编译器诊断和测试失败提供基于源码的上下文。 图 3 展示了生成的文档示例。

paragraphs.en: We derive a file-level generation plan from the specification documents, translation contract, and source evidence. The plan specifies each target Rust file’s generation order, the C source files it covers, and its dependencies on other planned Rust files. For each file, we assemble a focused context package combining the relevant module specification, the project-level rewrite context, and interface summaries of its dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从规格文档、翻译契约和源码证据中推导出文件级的生成计划。 该计划规定了每个目标 Rust 文件的生成顺序、它覆盖的 C 源文件，以及它对其他计划中 Rust 文件的依赖。 对于每个文件，我们组装一个聚焦的上下文包，其中结合了相关模块规格、项目级改写上下文，以及其依赖项的接口摘要。

paragraphs.en: We generate Rust files in the dependency order defined by the file plan, using the assembled context package as the primary input. When additional evidence is needed, ContextualRustAgent retrieves C source excerpts or previously generated Rust files to supplement the context. When generation reaches the model’s output limit, we append the produced content as a prefix and resume generation, allowing large files to be completed across multiple passes. After generation, we extract the file’s exported function signatures and referenced symbols as an interface summary and register them in a live symbol registry. Subsequent files query the registry to reuse earlier results without rereading the full Rust repository. We then run a lint checker and apply lightweight structural fixes, resolving issues such as duplicate definitions and cross-file reference errors, before advancing to the next file. Figure 4 illustrates the registry format.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照文件计划定义的依赖顺序生成 Rust 文件，并以组装好的上下文包作为主要输入。 当需要额外证据时，ContextualRustAgent 会检索 C 源代码片段或先前生成的 Rust 文件来补充上下文。 当生成达到模型的输出上限时，我们将已生成的内容作为前缀附加并继续生成，使大文件可以通过多次生成来完成。 生成完成后，我们提取该文件导出的函数签名和被引用的符号作为接口摘要，并将其注册到实时符号注册表中。 后续文件通过查询该注册表来复用先前的结果，而无需重新读取整个 Rust 代码库。 随后，我们运行 lint 检查器并进行轻量级结构修复，解决诸如重复定义和跨文件引用错误等问题，然后再处理下一个文件。 图 4 展示了该注册表的格式。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3 repairs the generated Rust project using compiler diagnostics and C/Rust behavioral differences, drawing on Stage 1 specifications and Stage 2 interface summaries as repair context. It consists of four steps: execution environment alignment , structural normalization , compilation-Guided Repair , and test-driven repair closure .

paragraphs.en: Before model-based repair, we apply rule-based preprocessing to the generated Rust project to remove structural artifacts that can be resolved without model inference, including formatting errors, invalid module declarations, residual syntax fragments, and import issues. This allows later repair rounds to focus on substantive errors such as type mismatches, ownership violations, and interface mismatches.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于模型的修复之前，我们首先对生成的 Rust 项目应用基于规则的预处理，以移除那些无需模型推理即可解决的结构性瑕疵，包括格式错误、无效的模块声明、残留的语法片段以及导入问题。 这使得后续的修复轮次能够专注于实质性错误，例如类型不匹配、所有权违规和接口不匹配。

paragraphs.en: We organize the repair loop into major and minor rounds. Minor rounds iterate over active batches. Major rounds maintain repair memory and trigger rollback when progress stalls. RustRepairAgent repairs each batch using a layered prompt with five components. The repair protocol layer encodes stable repair rules. The failure instance layer describes the current batch using minimized diagnostics and candidate causes. The project knowledge layer provides specifications, module responsibilities, and inter-file dependencies from earlier stages. The evidence retrieval layer supplies Rust code slices, C source excerpts, and execution traces for the current diagnosis. The repair memory layer records the current analysis, attempted repair directions, and edit summaries across rounds. Figure 5 shows this prompt organization. After each patch, we rerun compilation and update the repair memory with the remaining diagnostics and applied edits. If a major round reaches its repair limit without sufficient progress, we restore the code snapshot from the start of that round and retry.

paragraphs.en: After the Rust project compiles, we run the original test scripts on both the C reference and the Rust program. We compare their execution results, including outputs, exit status, runtime failures, and assertion failures, and convert each behavioral difference into a failure instance. We then construct a compact repair input from minimized test differences, execution traces, and relevant C/Rust code evidence. The repair agent combines this feedback with project knowledge and source evidence to fix behavioral mismatches such as boundary conditions, integer behavior, error paths, and cross-module calls. The loop terminates when the Rust project compiles and passes all end-to-end tests.
paragraphs.zh: Rust 项目编译通过后，我们在 C 参考实现和 Rust 程序上运行原始测试脚本。 我们比较两者的执行结果，包括输出、退出状态、运行时失败和断言失败，并将每个行为差异转化为一个失败实例。 然后我们基于最小化的测试差异、执行轨迹以及相关的 C/Rust 代码证据，构建一个紧凑的修复输入。 修复智能体将这些反馈与项目知识和源代码证据相结合，以修复行为不匹配问题，例如边界条件、整数行为、错误路径和跨模块调用。 当 Rust 项目编译通过并通过所有端到端测试时，该循环终止。

sents.zh: 我们比较两者的执行结果，包括输出、退出状态、运行时失败和断言失败，并将每个行为差异转化为一个失败实例。

sents.en: We then construct a compact repair input from minimized test differences, execution traces, and relevant C/Rust code evidence.
sents.zh: 然后我们基于最小化的测试差异、执行轨迹以及相关的 C/Rust 代码证据，构建一个紧凑的修复输入。

sents.en: The repair agent combines this feedback with project knowledge and source evidence to fix behavioral mismatches such as boundary conditions, integer behavior, error paths, and cross-module calls.
sents.zh: 修复智能体将这些反馈与项目知识和源代码证据相结合，以修复行为不匹配问题，例如边界条件、整数行为、错误路径和跨模块调用。

sents.en: The loop terminates when the Rust project compiles and passes all end-to-end tests.
sents.zh: 当 Rust 项目编译通过并通过所有端到端测试时，该循环终止。

Our dataset contains eight projects: c4 [ 15 ] , yank [ 19 ] , sds [ 20 ] , which [ 21 ] , cat [ 22 ] , pwd [ 23 ] , shc [ 24 ] , and cflow [ 25 ] . Their sizes range from 418 to 49,757 lines of C code. Each project is accompanied by end-to-end shell test scripts. Table I summarizes the dataset composition. paragraphs.en: We compare SpeC2Rust against four representative baselines:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SpeC2Rust 与四个具有代表性的基线进行了比较：

paragraphs.en: C2Rust [ 3 ] is a rule-based open-source toolchain for translating C code (primarily targeting the C99 standard) into Rust.
paragraphs.zh: C2Rust [ 3 ] 是一个基于规则的开源工具链，用于将 C 代码（主要针对 C99 标准）翻译为 Rust。

paragraphs.en: C2SaferRust [ 8 ] takes the unsafe Rust code produced by C2Rust , first partitions the code into chunks, and then combines rule-based transformations with LLM-based rewriting to translate unsafe Rust into safer Rust.
paragraphs.zh: C2SaferRust [8] 对 C2Rust 生成的非安全 Rust 代码进行处理，首先将代码划分为多个代码块，然后将基于规则的转换与基于大语言模型的重写相结合，将非安全 Rust 翻译为更安全的 Rust。

paragraphs.en: EvoC2Rust [ 26 ] is a skeleton-driven translation tool that first constructs a corresponding Rust skeleton from the input C project and then uses LLM to generate code that fills the skeleton.
paragraphs.zh: EvoC2Rust [ 26 ] 是一个由骨架驱动的翻译工具，它首先根据输入的 C 项目构建对应的 Rust 骨架，然后使用大语言模型（LLM）生成代码来填充该骨架。

paragraphs.en: SmartC2Rust [ 9 ] is an iterative, feedback-driven C-to-Rust translation approach via large language models for safety and equivalence, and it serves as our primary comparison point.
paragraphs.zh: SmartC2Rust [ 9 ] 是一种通过大型语言模型进行 C 到 Rust 翻译的迭代式、反馈驱动方法，旨在保障安全性与等价性，它是我们主要的对比对象。

paragraphs.en: Following prior work on C-to-Rust translation [ 9 , 8 , 27 ] , we evaluate SpeC2Rust from three perspectives: safety, semantic equivalence, and cost. The same metric abbreviations are used throughout the later RQs.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循先前关于 C 到 Rust 翻译的研究 [9, 8, 27]，我们从安全性、语义等价性和成本三个角度评估 SpeC2Rust。 相同的指标缩写在后续的研究问题中贯穿使用。

paragraphs.en: Safety metrics. We use three safety-related metrics: unsafe lines of code ( uLoC ), raw-pointer declarations ( Decl. ), and raw-pointer dereferences ( Deref. ). These metrics capture how much low-level unsafe behavior remains in the translated Rust project.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性指标。 我们使用三个与安全性相关的指标：不安全代码行数（uLoC）、裸指针声明（Decl.）以及裸指针解引用（Deref.）。 这些指标衡量了翻译后的 Rust 项目中还残留多少底层的不安全行为。

paragraphs.zh: 语义等价性指标。 我们报告编译成功（Comp.）和测试通过状态/比率（Tests Passed）。 遵循已有工作，语义等价性通过翻译后的 Rust 项目能否成功编译，以及在原始端到端测试脚本下能否保持原始 C 项目的可观察行为来评估。

paragraphs.en: In all LLM-based experiments, we use the gpt-5.4 API model with max_tokens set to 8192. For evaluation consistency, we place all test scripts under test/ at the root of each C project and copy them into the translated Rust repository after generation. We keep these scripts unchanged and only redirect the executable path from the original C binary to the translated Rust binary. This setup lets us evaluate semantic preservation with the original project tests while avoiding any LLM-driven rewriting of the evaluation scripts.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有基于大语言模型的实验中，我们使用 gpt-5.4 API 模型，并将 max_tokens 设置为 8192。 为保证评估的一致性，我们将所有测试脚本置于每个 C 项目根目录下的 test/ 目录中，并在生成后将其复制到翻译后的 Rust 仓库中。 我们保持这些脚本不变，仅将可执行文件路径从原始 C 二进制文件重定向到翻译后的 Rust 二进制文件。 这种设置使我们能够使用原始项目的测试来评估语义保持性，同时避免任何由大语言模型驱动的对评估脚本的重写。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SpeC2Rust on eight C projects and compare it against representative C-to-Rust translation baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在八个 C 项目上评估 SpeC2Rust，并将其与代表性的 C 到 Rust 翻译基线进行比较。

paragraphs.en: This section focuses on the following research questions:

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How effective is SpeC2Rust at improving translation safety compared with representative C-to-Rust translation baselines?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：与代表性的 C 到 Rust 翻译基线方法相比，SpeC2Rust 在提升翻译安全性方面的效果如何？

paragraphs.en: Table III summarizes the semantic-equivalence results of SpeC2Rust . Across all eight projects in the evaluation dataset, the translated Rust projects compile successfully and pass the original end-to-end test scripts. In contrast, SmartC2Rust fails to compile on four projects in the current result sheet, and EvoC2Rust does not produce a successful translation for any project in our dataset. C2SaferRust compiles on all projects, because each rewritten function is checked by compilation and testing before replacing its original unsafe counterpart; when the rewritten version fails, the pipeline falls back to the corresponding C2Rust output to preserve buildability. From the perspective of completed repository-level translations, SpeC2Rust is also the only method in the current evaluation that simultaneously provides full eight-project coverage and zero-unsafe outputs. EvoC2Rust does not produce a compilable translation on any of the eight projects. This coverage difference is important because safety improvements are only meaningful when they are achieved on completed repository translations.

paragraphs.en: We conducted an ablation study to understand how the major components of SpeC2Rust contribute to the final translation performance. We evaluate all variants on the eight-project dataset. Our evaluation is based on the following two metrics: (i) compile rate, i.e., the fraction of projects whose translated Rust implementations compile successfully, and (ii) test pass rate, i.e., the average percentage of original end-to-end tests passed by the translated Rust implementations. Table V shows the results. The full system reaches 100.0% on both metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一项消融研究，以了解 SpeC2Rust 的主要组件如何影响最终的翻译性能。 我们在八个项目的数据集上评估所有变体。 我们的评估基于以下两个指标：（i）编译率，即翻译后的 Rust 实现能够成功编译的项目比例；（ii）测试通过率，即翻译后的 Rust 实现通过原始端到端测试的平均百分比。 表 V 展示了结果。 完整系统在两个指标上均达到 100.0%。

sents.en: We conducted an ablation study to understand how the major components of SpeC2Rust contribute to the final translation performance.

paragraphs.en: We use pwd as a case study to illustrate how SpeC2Rust addresses the C Project Intent challenge through specification-driven generation. In the original C implementation, the function robust_getcwd walks up the directory tree toward the root and compares device and inode numbers at each level to reconstruct the absolute path. This fallback logic is important when the system getcwd fails, for example because of PATH_MAX limits or restricted permissions on parent directories. Figure 7 compares the robust_getcwd translations produced by SmartC2Rust and SpeC2Rust from the same C source.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 pwd 为案例研究，说明 SpeC2Rust 如何通过基于规范的生成来应对 C 项目意图挑战。 在原始 C 实现中，函数 robust_getcwd 沿目录树向上遍历至根目录，并在每一层比较设备号和 inode 号，以重建绝对路径。 当系统 getcwd 失败时，例如由于 PATH_MAX 限制或父目录权限受限，这一回退逻辑非常重要。 图 7 比较了 SmartC2Rust 和 SpeC2Rust 从同一 C 源码生成的 robust_getcwd 翻译结果。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 7 (a), SmartC2Rust replaces the original directory-walking algorithm with a simple env::current_dir() call followed by path normalization. The translated code omits find_dir_entry , inode comparison, and the upward traversal logic. As a result, it passes through a simpler implementation rather than preserving the original algorithmic design. This reflects a broader limitation of feedback-driven repair: the LLM is encouraged to satisfy the available test suite, but not necessarily to retain the intent of the original C implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 7 (a) 所示，SmartC2Rust 用一个简单的 env::current_dir() 调用加路径规范化，替换了原来的目录遍历算法。 翻译后的代码省略了 find_dir_entry、inode 比较以及向上遍历的逻辑。 因此，它通过的是一个更简单的实现，而不是保留原有的算法设计。 这反映了反馈驱动修复的一个更广泛的局限：大模型被鼓励去满足现有的测试套件，但不一定保留原始 C 实现的意图。

paragraphs.en: This example highlights the role of SpeC2Rust ’s Project-Intent Structuring . paragraphs.zh: 本示例凸显了 SpeC2Rust 的项目意图结构化的作用。 通过显式地恢复 robust_getcwd 的预期行为——目录向上遍历加上基于 inode 的名称解析——该系统为生成提供了稳定、可复用的规范，而不是仅仅依赖测试。 在规范引导生成过程中，这些规范引导大语言模型重构原始的算法结构。

paragraphs.en: We identify three main threats to the validity of our study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出本研究有效性的三个主要威胁。

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. A primary threat is the non-deterministic nature of LLM-based translation and repair. Different runs may produce different Rust implementations, repair trajectories, and token costs. To reduce this threat, we run each project multiple times and report averaged results. Another threat concerns the quality of project knowledge produced in Stage 1. SpeC2Rust relies on Stage 1 to recover module boundaries, interface relations, and behavioral constraints from the input C repository [ 28 , 29 ] . Errors in this stage can propagate to later generation and repair steps. For example, missing behavioral constraints or incorrect decomposition of tightly coupled functions and data structures may lead to incomplete repair context. The ablation results in RQ4 show that both SpecGen and hierarchical decomposition affect end-to-end correctness [ 30 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 内部有效性。 一个主要威胁是基于大语言模型的翻译与修复的非确定性本质。 不同的运行可能产生不同的 Rust 实现、修复轨迹和令牌开销。 为降低这一威胁，我们对每个项目运行多次并报告平均结果。 另一个威胁涉及第一阶段产生的项目知识的质量。 SpeC2Rust 依赖第一阶段从输入的 C 代码库中恢复模块边界、接口关系和行为约束 [ 28 , 29 ] 。 该阶段中的错误可能传播到后续的生成与修复步骤。 例如，缺失行为约束或对紧密耦合的函数与数据结构的不当分解，可能导致修复上下文不完整。 RQ4 中的消融实验结果表明，SpecGen 与层次化分解都会影响端到端的正确性 [ 30 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Related work most relevant to SpeC2Rust falls into three lines: rule-based and safety-oriented C-to-Rust translation, program-analysis-guided and LLM-based translation, and feedback-driven repair or agent-based code generation.

paragraphs.en: Rule-based and safety-oriented C-to-Rust translation. Waters [ 37 ] provided an early abstraction-oriented view of program migration. In C-to-Rust translation, C2Rust [ 3 ] is the canonical rule-based approach: it largely preserves the original C decomposition and offers a practical migration starting point. However, Emre et al. [ 4 ] show that preserving semantic equivalence while removing raw pointers and unsafe code remains difficult. Later work pushes safety refinement further, including GenC2Rust [ 38 ] , C2SaferRust [ 8 ] , and PR2 [ 39 ] . These methods improve safety over direct transpilation, but they still mainly refine C-oriented skeletons rather than reconstructing the repository around explicit Rust-side specifications and module intent.

paragraphs.en: Program-analysis-guided and LLM-based C-to-Rust translation. Recent work increasingly combines static analysis, prompt engineering, and LLM generation for C-to-Rust translation. Eniser et al. [ 5 ] and Pan et al. [ 40 ] highlight common weaknesses of LLM-based Rust translation, including compilation failures, inconsistency, and translation-induced bugs. Other approaches add stronger structural guidance, including VERT [ 41 ] , a static-analysis-driven pipeline [ 42 ] , C2RustXW [ 27 ] , RustMap [ 43 ] , SpecTra [ 44 ] , and scalable whole-project translation with LLMs [ 10 ] . In the C-to-Rust setting, EvoC2Rust [ 26 ] shows that skeleton-guided generation can improve structural consistency over direct prompting. However, most existing approaches still use structure, analysis facts, or specifications mainly as prompt-time context rather than externalizing repository-level knowledge into persistent artifacts that can be reused across generation and repair.

paragraphs.en: Feedback-driven repair and agent-based translation. Another related line studies iterative correction with compiler diagnostics, test feedback, and agent-style tool use. This includes Rust compilation repair [ 45 ] , broader LLM-based automated program repair [ 7 ] , and agentic repair or translation frameworks such as RepairAgent [ 46 ] , LLM-powered translation agents [ 47 ] , and TRANSAGENT [ 48 ] . paragraphs.en: This paper presented SpeC2Rust , a specification-driven pipeline for repository-level C-to-Rust translation. The core idea of SpeC2Rust is to externalize repository-level knowledge before Rust generation, preserve it as reusable specification artifacts, and selectively reinject it during generation and repair through Project-Intent Structuring , Spec-Guided Generation , and Layered-Feedback Repair . We evaluated SpeC2Rust on eight repository-level open-source C projects, and the results show that it compiles successfully and passes the original end-to-end test scripts on all eight projects, while eliminating raw-pointer declarations, raw-pointer dereferences, and unsafe lines of code in the final translated Rust repositories. On the five projects where direct comparison with SmartC2Rust is possible, SpeC2Rust reduces monetary cost by 66.1%, end-to-end latency by 77.3%, and input-token usage by 84.7%. Future work could extend this direction to broader classes of C systems, including library projects, and combine specification-guided translation with stronger validation techniques such as fuzzing and differential testing.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 SpeC2Rust，一种规格说明驱动的仓库级 C 到 Rust 翻译流水线。 SpeC2Rust 的核心思想是，在生成 Rust 代码之前将仓库级知识外部化，将其保存为可复用的规格说明工件，并通过项目意图结构化、规格引导生成和分层反馈修复，在生成与修复过程中选择性地将其重新注入。 我们在八个仓库级开源 C 项目上评估了 SpeC2Rust，结果表明，它在全部八个项目上都能成功编译并通过原始的端到端测试脚本，同时在最终翻译得到的 Rust 仓库中消除了裸指针声明、裸指针解引用以及不安全的代码行。 在五个可与 SmartC2Rust 直接比较的项目上，SpeC2Rust 将货币成本降低了 66.1%，端到端延迟降低了 77.3%，输入 token 用量降低了 84.7%。 未来的工作可以将这一方向扩展到更广泛的 C 系统类别（包括库项目），并将规格说明引导的翻译与模糊测试和差分测试等更强的验证技术相结合。
